name: Clean Cars for All - EV
description: $10,000-$12,000 grant to buy or lease a battery electric car ($9,500-$11,500 for plug-in hybrid) when trading in a 2007 or older gas/diesel vehicle; plus up to $2,000 for EV charging
fullDescription: The Bay Area Air Quality Management District's Clean Cars for All program provides substantial incentives for income-qualified residents to replace older polluting vehicles with new or used electric vehicles.
whatTheyOffer:
- $10,000-$12,000 grant for a battery electric vehicle (higher amount for disadvantaged community residents)
- $9,500-$11,500 for a plug-in hybrid
- Up to $2,000 for EV charging
- Up to $5,000 more for adaptive equipment
- Trade in a 2007 or older gas or diesel vehicle
howToGetIt:
1. Must live in the Air District's Bay Area jurisdiction (9-county region)
2. Household income at or below 300% federal poverty level (e.g., $47,880 for 1 person, $99,000 for 4)
3. Own an operational 2007 or older gas/diesel vehicle continuously registered in California for the past 2 years
4. Register and apply online; GRID Alternatives (855-256-3656) helps with applications
5. Wait for your Award Letter BEFORE buying; cars bought earlier or from non-authorized dealers are ineligible
6. Trade in old vehicle and buy/lease qualifying EV at a participating dealer
address: 375 Beale Street, Suite 600, San Francisco, CA 94105
keywords: Clean Cars for All, BAAQMD, electric vehicle, EV rebate, $10000, trade-in, used EV, low-income, car replacement
